details: The US Treasury Department has sanctioned a Cambodian senator for allegedly operating crypto scam centers, as part of a broader crackdown on illicit cryptocurrency activities. This action emphasizes the ongoing global efforts by US authorities to combat crypto-related fraud.
title: US Sanctions Cambodian Senator for Crypto Scams

details: Bitcoin is currently facing a critical test around the $80,000 price level. Market volatility is being influenced by significant buying activity from large holders ("whales") and institutional investors through Bitcoin ETFs, as the market navigates a potential breakout or pullback.
title: Bitcoin Tests $80K as Whales & ETFs Drive Volatility

details: JPMorgan has indicated that persistent exploits within the Decentralized Finance (DeFi) sector and stagnant Total Value Locked (TVL) continue to be significant barriers to greater institutional adoption of DeFi protocols. This reflects ongoing concerns from traditional finance regarding the security and stability of decentralized platforms.
title: JPMorgan: DeFi Exploits Limit Institutional Adoption

details: Tether has frozen approximately $344 million in USDT stablecoins on the Tron network after the associated wallets were flagged by US authorities. This move demonstrates Tether's compliance with law enforcement directives, highlighting the centralized control aspects of stablecoin operations.
title: Tether Freezes $344M USDT on Tron Amid US Flagging

details: An admiral informed Congress that the US military is operating a Bitcoin node to conduct operational tests and explore its potential applications for national security. This indicates a growing interest within governmental sectors in leveraging blockchain technology beyond its financial implications.
title: US Military Explores Bitcoin Node for Security Use

details: The UK government has announced plans to incorporate stablecoins and tokenized deposits into its existing regulatory framework for payments. This initiative aims to establish clear rules and promote innovation within the digital asset landscape in the United Kingdom.
title: UK Integrates Stablecoins, Tokenized Deposits in Payments Rules

details: Venture capital firm Blockchain Capital is reportedly looking to raise $700 million for two new cryptocurrency funds, focusing on both early-stage and growth investments. This signifies a strong institutional appetite and continued capital influx into the cryptocurrency and blockchain industry.
title: Blockchain Capital Seeks $700M for New Crypto Funds

details: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) platforms have collectively seen losses surpass $600 million, primarily due to the Kelp DAO exploit. This incident has also driven the Total Value Locked (TVL) in DeFi to a one-year low, raising substantial concerns about the security and resilience of certain DeFi protocols.
title: DeFi Losses Exceed $600M From Kelp DAO Exploit
